description: This file contains function prototypes and macro guards for the exported API of the Bwsp Site Creator object in the Broadway Web Service Plane implementation. It declares functions for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the site creator object.

methods.name: BwspCreateSiteCreator
methods.description: Creates a site creator object with given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BwspScoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the site creator object with specified contexts.

methods.name: BwspScoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the site creator object.

methods.name: BwspScoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the site creator object.
